## Welcome to Basheer's Blog

Welcome to my blog. This is a space where I write about technology, AI, embedded systems, and software engineering.

This blog runs on a fully automated zero-cost stack: Hugo for static site generation, GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare for CDN/DNS, GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Google Gemini for AI content generation, and N8N for workflow automation.

Topics covered include AI & Machine Learning, Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Cloud & DevOps, and Building in Public.
